description: P2-2 L-corner segment assignment (#4) and P2-3 Per-zone dimension annotations (#28). (A) Auto-assign zones to SEGMENT_A or SEGMENT_B based on position relative to the corner boundary in L_CORNER templates. Zones cannot cross the corner boundary. Show segment in ZonePropertiesPanel. (B) Render dimension lines with mm labels on each zone's edges.
steps: 1. Add `segment` field to TemplateZone interface in frontend/src/types/database.ts: `segment: 'SEGMENT_A' | 'SEGMENT_B' | null`. This matches the DB schema column.

2. Create frontend/src/canvas/utils/segmentAssignment.ts: pure function `assignSegment(zone: {x_mm, y_mm, width_mm, height_mm}, cornerAt: {x: number, y: number}, wallGeometry: WallGeometry): 'SEGMENT_A' | 'SEGMENT_B' | null`. For STRAIGHT walls return null. For L_CORNER: if zone's right edge (x_mm + width_mm) <= cornerAt.x, it is in SEGMENT_A. If zone's left edge (x_mm) >= cornerAt.x, it is in SEGMENT_B. If it straddles, return null (invalid state).

3. Create frontend/src/canvas/utils/segmentConstraint.ts: pure function `doesZoneCrossCorner(zone: BoundingBox, cornerAt: {x: number, y: number}): boolean`. Returns true if zone straddles the corner boundary. This is used to prevent creation/drag/resize across the corner.
4. Update useZoneCreate.ts: after creation, if wall_geometry is L_CORNER, compute segment assignment and reject creation if zone crosses corner boundary.
5. Update useZoneDrag.ts handleDragEnd: if L_CORNER, reject drag that would cause zone to cross corner boundary (revert like overlap does).
6. Update useZoneResize.ts handleResizeEnd: if L_CORNER, reject resize that would cause zone to cross corner boundary.
7. Update projectStore.ts updateZone: after position/size changes, auto-compute and set zone.segment based on position.
8. Update ZonePropertiesPanel.tsx: show segment assignment as a read-only badge (SEGMENT_A / SEGMENT_B / Unassigned) below zone name. Only shown when wallGeometry is L_CORNER.

9. For per-zone dimension annotations: Create frontend/src/canvas/layers/ZoneDimensionsLayer.tsx following MeasurementsLayer.tsx pattern. For each zone, render small dimension lines with mm labels along the width (bottom edge) and height (right edge) of the zone. Use thin lines with tick marks at ends and centered text labels showing width_mm and height_mm. Layer is always visible in DESIGNER mode.
10. Add ZoneDimensionsLayer to CanvasContainer.tsx between MeasurementsLayer and SelectionLayer. Register in CanvasLayer enum as ZONE_DIMENSIONS.

11. Add tests: frontend/src/canvas/__tests__/segmentAssignment.test.ts (auto-assignment logic, cross-corner detection) and frontend/src/canvas/__tests__/zoneDimensions.test.ts (layer renders dimension text for each zone).
acceptance_criteria: For L_CORNER templates, zones are auto-assigned to SEGMENT_A or SEGMENT_B based on position
Zone creation/drag/resize is rejected if it would cross the corner boundary
ZonePropertiesPanel shows segment badge for L_CORNER templates
Per-zone dimension annotations show width and height labels on zone edges
All existing tests pass, new tests pass
verification: cd /projects/sandbox/Bom/frontend && unset NODE_OPTIONS && npx vitest run
findings: All 879 tests pass (up from 859 with 20 new tests). Pre-existing TS errors in usePermissionEnforcement.test.ts and ValidationOverlayLayer.tsx remain (unrelated to this feature). Fixed pre-existing display_order typo in multiSelect/canvasStore.multiSelect test helpers. The segment field was added to TemplateZone interface which required updating makeZone helpers across many test files.
